Director; Chair, Sustainability Nominating and Governance Committee; Member, Audit Committee
Not disclosed; no disagreements with the Company
John Replogle appointed to Audit Committee to replace Ms. Sramek; Sustainability, Nominating and Governance Committee size reduced from three to two

Founder & CEO of HumanCo since 2019; co‑founder and former chairman of Hu Chocolate (sold 2021); former founder & CEO of Tourbillon Capital Partners (2011–2018); board member of True Food Kitchen since Sept 2022; B.S. Economics, Wharton (summa cum laude)
Served as chair of Sustainability Nominating and Governance Committee and member of Audit Committee
Determined independent under NYSE standards; will enter standard indemnification agreement; will not receive board compensation
Replaced on Audit Committee by John Replogle; committee chair position and committee membership adjusted as noted
